title: Exeter wobbling disc

tellings.quote: four people, two cops see a large disc from a 100 feet away and a 100 feet altitude engaging in a wobbling motion.

plain: In 1964 in Exeter, New Hampshire, four people, two of them police officers, are said to have watched a large disc wobble in the air about 100 feet away and 100 feet up. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff tells Michels this without naming a source, as a case where trained, credible witnesses saw something up close.
